title: Peppered strawberries and ricotta on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Strawberries, honey, almonds, ricotta and wholemeal bread are all plain foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard, everyday-priced item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small frying pan, a toaster and a bowl, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: Two slices each, with about 60g ricotta and 100g strawberries per person, makes a sensible breakfast for four, and the steps are clear.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers hulling the strawberries, toasting the almonds, zesting and making the toast, and the 10 cook minutes match the strawberries' standing time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon, mint and pepper, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fresh strawberries are the point of this mid-May breakfast and suit the season.

plain_voice.reason: It reads plainly in British English with steps a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with ricotta, fruit and nuts is a balanced, appealing family breakfast with little added sugar.
